#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string input, result;
    cin >> input;
    int length = input.size();
    result = "";
    result += input[0];
    bool replaced_at = false;
    int index = 1;
    while (index < length) {
        if (!replaced_at && index < length - 2 && input[index] == 'a' && input[index + 1] == 't') {
            result += "@";
            replaced_at = true;
            index++;
        } else if (index < length - 2 && input.substr(index, 3) == "dot") {
            result += ".";
            index += 2;
        } else {
            result += input[index];
        }
        index++;
    }
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
